name: Airborne Ranger: FightOut
detailed_description:
Features

Single-player

Embark on a gripping solo campaign filled with unexpected twists, immersive storytelling, and a wide variety of mission objectives that will challenge your tactics and keep you hooked from start to finish.

Multiplayer

Team up with friends in cooperative missions or face off in competitive deathmatch modes. Coordinate tactics, share resources, and experience intense online action together.

Character Customization

Transform your character from a standard recruit into a battle-hardened elite. Mix and match gear, uniforms, and equipment to suit your playstyle and mission needs.

Weapon Customization

Upgrade your arsenal with a wide range of attachments. Fine-tune your weapons for stealth, precision, or all-out firepower.

Open World Map

Explore a vast, stunning open world packed with detail and danger. From dense forests to enemy-held compounds, every location offers tactical opportunities.

Military Tactics

Execute a range of real-world military tactics—flanking, suppressive fire, stealth infiltration, and more. Adapt your strategy to overcome any challenge.

Vehicles

Commandeer jeeps, trucks, and boats to traverse terrain, support your squad, or make a quick getaway under fire.

Survival

Scavenge, hunt, and craft to stay alive in hostile environments. Track animals, gather herbs, and use nature to your advantage.

Destructible Environment

Blast through barriers, level enemy defenses, and change the battlefield dynamically—almost everything can be destroyed.

Day / Night Cycle

Adapt to a fully immersive day-night cycle. Use the cover of night for stealth operations or strike hard in daylight when visibility is high.


About the Game

Airborne Ranger: Fightout

Gear up and step into the boots of an elite Airborne Ranger in Airborne Ranger: Fightout, a thrilling tactical-action game that puts you behind enemy lines to carry out daring and high-stakes missions. Whether operating solo or as part of a four-player co-op team, you'll need skill, strategy, and courage to complete your objectives and make it to the extraction point alive.

A Modern Successor to a Classic

Inspired by MicroProse’s groundbreaking 1987 title Airborne Ranger, this modern reimagining captures the core intensity of elite special operations. With enhanced visuals, authentic mechanics and tight squad-based gameplay, Fightout honors the original while delivering a fresh, approachable experience for both solo and co-op play enthusiasts.

Whether you're a veteran of mil-sims or a squad shooter enthusiast, Fightout offers the tools and freedom to approach missions your way— through stealth, firepower, or a mix of both.

Key Features:

  • Elite Ranger Missions:
    Take on a variety of challenging operations, including:

    • Intercepting Enemy Supplies: Ambush and destroy supply convoys or infiltrate depots to seize critical resources and disrupt enemy logistics.

    • Destroying Enemy Artillery: Locate and eliminate long-range artillery positions to protect friendly forces or prevent bombardment of key locations.

    • Assassination Missions: Neutralize key enemy leaders or operatives deep within hostile territory.

    • Neutralizing Enemy Patrols: Take out reconnaissance or counter-intelligence units to secure safe passage for friendly forces.

    • Marking Airstrike Targets: Sneak into enemy territory to designate high-value targets for aerial bombardment or drone strikes.

    • Infiltrating Communications Hubs: Hack or destroy enemy communications networks to disrupt their operations and coordination.

    • Securing Key Assets: Steal advanced technology, enemy prototypes, or sensitive documents from high-security installations.

    • Sabotaging Vehicle Depots: Disable enemy tanks, APCs, or helicopters to weaken their combat capabilities.

    • Scouting and Reconnaissance: Gather critical battlefield data, including enemy numbers, movements, and defensive structures, for upcoming operations.

    • Recovering Downed Aircraft equipment: Secure sensitive materials or personnel from crashed allied planes or helicopters before the enemy can reach them.

    • Setting Demolition Charges: Plant explosives to destroy key bridges, railways, or other infrastructure to cripple enemy mobility.

    • Evacuating Friendly Agents: Escort allied spies or defectors out of enemy-controlled areas to safety.

Tactical Freedom, Real Consequences

Every drop behind enemy lines starts with limited gear and intel. Plan your insertion, adapt your strategy mid-mission, and rely on skill and awareness to overcome unpredictable threats.

Extraction isn't a Given

Completing the objective is only half the mission. Reach your extraction point under fire, improvise when plans fall apart, and fight to survive until the chopper arrives.

Built for Co-op and Solo Operations

Tactically coordinate with up to three teammates, or tackle missions on your own. Shared resources, communication, and synchronized execution are key in co-op—but solo players can rely on stealth and precision to outmaneuver the enemy.

Realistic, Immersive Environments

From dense jungle routes to fortified compounds and cold urban warzones, each mission map is handcrafted for tactical variety and replayability

Deep Loadouts and Progression

Equip your ranger with a wide arsenal of modern weapons, gear, and gadgets. Customize your playstyle, unlock new tools, and develop your loadout across evolving mission chains.

Replayability with Purpose

No two missions are the same—thanks to procedural elements, dynamic AI, and evolving objectives. Track your career, earn upgrades, and prove yourself across increasingly difficult operations.

Whether you're here for the authentic mil-sim vibes or just want to squad up and crush some high-stakes missions with friends, Airborne Ranger: Fightout delivers tactical depth and explosive co-op action like no other.

Plan. Execute. Extract. Survive. 

Your mission starts now.

short_description: Gear up in Airborne Ranger: Fightout, a thrilling tactical-action game. Play solo or jump in 4-player co-op as you take on missions behind enemy lines—eliminate targets, gather intel, sabotage infrastructure and rescue hostages. Rely on skill, strategy, and courage to survive and make it out alive!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit versions only)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2400 | AMD FX-6100, or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 | AMD Radeon R9 290, or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 40 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Direct X Compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit versions only)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-3770 | AMD FX-8350, or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1060 6GB / AMD Radeon RX 480 4GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 40 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Direct X Compatible

content_descriptors.notes: FightOut is a mature game that regularly depicts violence and gore through combat, strong language, and adult situations.
